'''''Hunter''''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]], it was active in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] about two years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, along with the Nebulon B Frigate [[Avenger (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Avenger'']], it launched an attack on the [[Habassa]]n freighter group [[Starlifter (freighters)|''Starlifter'']]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and a number of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-Wings]] were successful in holding off the attack destroying both frigates.
